''See also: [[Lightning Spear Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Lightning Spear is a powerful projectile weapon used in combat. It features a construction of black wood, gold, ruby, and [[steel]]. When thrown, the weapon travels with immense speed and force that far exceeds a normal human's physical capability. It is capable of causing significant destruction, such as punching holes through stone floors and creating craters of rubble. The weapon appears to have a connection to its wielder, as it can be summoned back to their hand or obey their calls. However, using the weapon can take a heavy physical toll on the user, potentially causing them great pain or even death. While it is typically controlled by its owner, an [[Incarnation]] has demonstrated the ability to seize and hold the weapon against its will.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Leah]] initially carries the tall Lightning Spear in her right hand before leaving it to rest against a nearby wall. Although [[Zakareth]]'s daughter had kept the weapon for several weeks, [[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]] eventually wields it to blast through ground and tiles. The spear is a weapon associated with the lineage of [[King Zakareth the Sixth]], and it was once held in an [[Iron|iron]] grip by [[Leah's father]]. During a confrontation, the weapon is used to attack [[King Zakareth VI|King Zakareth]], though he manages to catch a Lightning Spear in his palm.}}
